categories.name: Direct Payment
categories.description: Cases where the fine is paid promptly or directly after creation without extensive administrative escalation or collection procedures.
categories.rationale: Represents low-duration and short-trace variants that cleanly result in payment early in the lifecycle.

categories.name: Standard Fine Lifecycle with Penalties
categories.description: Typical administrative process involving fine creation, notification, addition of penalties, and ultimate resolution either via payment or escalation to credit collection.
categories.rationale: Captures the most frequent high-volume variants containing standard notification, penalty addition, and eventual collection or payment.

categories.name: Payment Rework Heavy
categories.description: Variants characterized by repeated payment activities occurring over extended durations or long traces.
categories.rationale: Identified by recurring payment actions and high trace lengths reflecting installment-like or repeated settlement behavior.

categories.name: Prefecture Appeal and Legal Escalation
categories.description: Complex variants involving formal appeals to the prefecture or judge, processing of results, and notification of outcomes.
categories.rationale: Groups cases that deviate from standard payment paths into legal or administrative appeals.
